analysis.deterministic_psnr_ceiling_note: All deterministic candidates cap at ~26.3 dB, far below the >40 dB required for a deterministic exact match; the remaining structured residual is explained by the stochastic glass pixel-shuffle realization (skill: do not chase PSNR for non-deterministic blur) plus the residual tone gap.
